arjun: Heads-up — replayed canary for raven-int8 with our toolcall-heavy prompt set. Parse failures jumped to ~4.2% vs ~0.7% on float32. Putting notes here and a tiny repro command. s3 replay: s3://redwood-canary/replays/4187654321 :eyes:

arjun: Quick command I used: `./replay_canary.sh --model raven-int8 --since 2024-03-01 --prompts toolcall-heavy`

mike: Can you paste the stderr snippet where the JSON parse fails? curious whether it's truncated suffix or bad delimiters.

arjun: gist of failures (grep):
```
parse_error: unexpected '}' at token 312
parse_error: trailing garbage after JSON array
parse_error: incomplete object, hit EOF
```
Most errors cluster where KV-prefix > 256 tokens and when batch size >= 8.

linda: Interesting. Did you try turning off continuous batching / set batch=1 for the canary? That would isolate batching effects from quantization.

arjun: Yep — batch=1 drops failures to ~1.1% on int8 (still > float). Also tried `--kv-prefix-truncate 200` which reduced trailing-garbage errors by ~45%.

replay-bot: Canary summary for 4187654321: model=raven-int8, runs=1200, parse_fail=4.18%, median-latency=242ms, tags=[toolcall,kv-heavy]

mike: If truncation helps, could be a tokenization/serialization boundary when kvcache is materialized in the runtime. Can you capture the raw token stream around one failure (±40 tokens)?

arjun: Captured one sample and diffed against float: main discrepancy is a spurious zero-byte between tokens at boundary. Suspect a kernel-level packing step for int8 that inserts a sentinel byte in rare cases.

sara: If that holds up, we should add a defensive post-process step in the parser to drop obvious control chars before JSON parsing. Also file an infra bug for the packing logic.

linda: For immediate canary hygiene, recommend: 1) enable kv-prefix-truncate=200 for int8 canaries, 2) run a small float vs int8 parity replay on 10k prompts, 3) add sanitizer to parser to strip \u0000 and other low-control chars before parse.

arjun: I'll run the 10k parity replay tomorrow and upload results. Created a short PR with the sanitizer (small regex) and will link after CI passes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
